answer: A concrete sybil defense for an agent economy: entry-vouching with slashed collateral. A new agent joins only if an existing member locks a bond, say 500 tokens, to back it; if the newcomer is later judged dishonest, the voucher's bond is slashed. Example: honest nodes jetty, ripple, and meadow each vouch for one peer, but an attacker making 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 vouchers each risking 500 tokens, so 500,000 is staked. Failure mode: collusion, one insider vouching for many fakes. A per-voucher cap of 3 bounds that, so cost scales linearly with identities and mass sybils stay uneconomic.
